name: Orog
body:
Orogs are a reclusive subspecies orcs, most often found living in secluded mountain communities, in deep subterranean mines, or in lost kingdoms unseen since the world was young. Many consider them to be the result of interbreeding with ogres or other large humanoids at some point in the distant past. However, orogs themselves consider their heritage to be the most pure expression of orc blood, unsullied by the human interbreeding that has tainted many orc bloodlines elsewhere.

Physical

Orogs stand a good deal taller than standard orcs, averaging 6-1/2 to 7 feet in height with the tallest reaching almost 8 feet. Many have hunchbacks, strange growths, and twisted, misshapen limbs. They are much paler in complexion than standard orcs, with very light green, gray, or alabaster skin. Like standard orcs, they have beady red eyes and protruding tusks.

Social

Orogs are just as malicious and cruel as standard orcs, but are far more disciplined.

Orogs who mingle with standard orcs naturally gravitate to positions of leadership. However, they just as often refuse to deal with “lesser” orcs, seeing them as too lazy and unruly.

Orog communities are small but fierce. They maintain a strict, militaristic hierarchy, and expect every member to contribute. All but the most remote communities also capture members of other species to keep as slaves.

Alignment And Religion

Like orcs, orogs exhibit violent and cruel tendencies and seem to delight in the suffering of others. Most favor a structured approach that emphasizes self-control and coordination, making Lawful Evil the most common alignment among them. However, their approach to religion tends to be just as fluid as standard orcs. Each community piecemeals together its own pantheon, and these are largely matters of convenience—just as likely to include demons as devils.

Core Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are exceptionally strong, but somewhat weakwilled and slow to react. Your ability score modifiers are +4 Str, –2 Dex, –2 Wis [greater paragon]. (2)
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. (0)
Type You are a Humanoid with the orc subtype. (0)
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Orc. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Dwarven, Giant, Goblin, Terran, and Undercommon. (0)
Other Traits
Darkvision You have darkvision 60 feet. (2)
Light Sensitivity You are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell. (–1)
Blood You count as an orc for any effect related to species. You can select feats, traits, favored class bonuses, and other features available to orcs. (0)
Powerful Build Your physical stature allows you to function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Whenever you are subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a Combat Maneuver Bonus or Combat Maneuver Defense (such as during grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), you are treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to you. You are also considered to be one size larger when determining the damage of your unarmed strikes, and when determining whether a creature’s special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect you. You can use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty. However, your space and reach remain those of a creature of your actual size. The benefts of this ancestry trait stack with the effects of powers, abilities, and spells that change your size category. (3)
Cave Dweller You gain a +1 bonus on Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Survival checks made underground. (1)
Master Tinker You gain a +1 bonus on Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering) checks. Additionally, you are treated as proficient with any weapon you have personally crafted. (2)
Total: 9 RP (standard)
Alternate Traits
Brute You are even stronger than most orogs, but you are not as sharp mentally. Your ability score modifiers are +6 Str, –2 Dex, –2 Int, –2 Wis, –2 Cha. This trait alters ability score modifiers and replaces powerful build.
Bully Bluff and Intimidate are always class skills for you. This trait replaces cave dweller.
Craftsman You gain a +2 species bonus on all Craft or Profession checks to create objects from metal or stone. This trait replaces cave dweller.
Mountaineer You are immune to altitude sickness and do not lose your Dexterity bonus to AC when making Climb checks or Acrobatics checks to cross narrow or slippery surfaces. This trait replaces cave dweller.
Orc Ferocity Once per day, when you are reduced to fewer than 0 hit points but are not killed, you can fight on for 1 more round as if disabled. At the end of your next turn, unless brought to above 0 hit points, you immediately fall unconscious and begins to die. This trait replaces master tinker.
Weapon Familiarity You are proficient with greataxes and falchions, and you treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon. This trait replaces master tinker.
